sloka: क्ष्वेलन्तश्च नदन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवङ्गमाः।लब्धलक्षा रघुसुतं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे ।। ६.९१.९५ ।।
transliteration: kṣvelantaśca nadantaśca garjantaśca plavaṅgamāḥ।labdhalakṣā raghusutaṁ parivāryopatasthire ।। 6.91.95 ।।

translations.english: Then Vanaras wagging their tails and lashing them announced slogans saying," Lakshmana is winning."
